name: BPTP Gaia Residences
summary: Project (BPTP Gaia Residences at Amstoria 102), Sector 102 Dwarka Expressway location, RERA GGM/963/695/2025/66 (dated 27.06.2025), under-construction status, starting price (~Rs 3.4-4.0 Cr) and 3 towers / 531 units are confirmed. Developer is listed under the project name instead of BPTP Limited, land area is inconsistent across sources (12.08/12 acres vs 3 or 1.68 acres for this phase), our configuration labels (T6/T8 types, 2,100 sq ft) do not state BHK or area basis (web: 3 BHK, 1,621-1,689 sq ft carpet), and we omit the possession date (Dec 2032 on most sources).

Developer is correct (BPTP) but the listed developer name is the project name, not 'BPTP Limited'.
